EVAL-F-002-S1.title: Define Provider Detail Schema and Contract
EVAL-F-002-S1.description: Define the response schema for provider detail including NPI credentials, demographics, and structured external research links (NPI, Healthgrades, state boards).

EVAL-F-002-S2.title: Implement NPI Registry Lookup Logic
EVAL-F-002-S2.description: Implement core service logic to query CMS NPI Registry API, parse provider credentials, normalize fields, and handle missing/partial or malformed API responses with graceful fallbacks.

EVAL-F-002-S3.title: Generate and Validate External Research Links
EVAL-F-002-S3.description: Construct standardized external research URLs (NPI, Healthgrades, state boards DE/MS/VA), classify links, validate via URL guardian (HEAD + AI verification), and handle failed validations with fallback or exclusion.

EVAL-F-002-S4.title: Expose Provider Detail via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-F-002-S4.description: Integrate provider detail lookup into evaluate_care_facade and expose as a tool endpoint routed through tool_router with strict Pydantic validation and contract enforcement for inputs/outputs.

EVAL-F-002-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Detail Lookup
EVAL-F-002-S5.description: Create unit and integration tests covering NPI lookup, credential parsing, error handling, link generation, URL validation, and end-to-end facade + tool_router integration.
